text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle and I drop by the mall to
find her a
folding umbrella.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow... So this is a foldin' umbrella?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I don't need one of these doodads! It
weighs a
ton and seems like a pain to
haul around!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, like the other day? Well, if it
happens again,
then...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll just hop under your umbrella! No
problem!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Even if there ain't a lot of space, I know
just what
to do! I'll squeeze up to ya real
tight and squish
my way in!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What?! You tellin' me you're not gonna
be by my
side, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Gosh... I never thought of that! I just
figured
you'd always be around...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That'd be a real pickle! I'd best go grab
myself an
umbrella!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But there're so many! I'm not sure which
one to
pick...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Which do ya reckon I should buy,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, this one'll suit me just fine! I can tell!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Looks like it shouldn't weigh down my
bag. You
weren't lying when ya said ya
can run with it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The following day...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Lemme borrow your umbrella!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Well, ya see, it needs some
patchin' up. I ran
so fast it got blown to
bits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before lending her my umbrella, I warn
her not to
run at full speed in the rain.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... But doesn't this one look a
smidge heavy?
Well, I'll give it a spin...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
'Scuse me! Can I test out this
heavy-lookin'
umbrella?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Haha, this one's got some real weight to
it! Way
more than I expected!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But color me surprised—it's growin' on
me! I could
use it as a barbell!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll take it! In fact, I'd like a hundred of
'em!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It takes a lot of work to convince her she
doesn't
need that many umbrellas...
